_readme: Per-fixture editorial content for BRYME match pages. Keyed by league slug, then by match slug (the same slug used in the URL /sports/{league}/matches/{slug}/). A fixture with an entry here becomes an indexable editorial page; a fixture without one stays a schedule entry only: noindex and out of the sitemap. Never invent injuries, suspensions, lineups or statistics - omit the field and the page prints an explicit 'not confirmed' state. Use: node scripts/editorial-queue.js to see which fixtures are due.

_schema.publishedAt: YYYY-MM-DD, required - the day the preview went live. Becomes datePublished.
_schema.updatedAt: YYYY-MM-DD - becomes dateModified and sitemap lastmod.
_schema.lastFiveMeetings: String or array of the last five meetings.
_schema.homeAwayForm: Home form of the host, away form of the visitor.
_schema.injuries: Only if confirmed by club/official source. Omit if unknown.
_schema.suspensions: Only if confirmed. Omit if unknown.
_schema.expectedLineups: Only if reported. Omit if unknown.
_schema.scorePrediction: BRYME editorial score prediction - clearly an opinion.
_schema.postMatch: Added AFTER the game: {publishedAt, whatHappened, tacticalDevelopments, keyPerformers, disappointing, vsPrediction, analysis}. The pre-match text above is never overwritten.

hull-vs-man-united.overview: Promoted Hull host Manchester United, now under Michael Carrick, in their first top-flight home match of the new campaign.
hull-vs-man-united.recentForm: Hull won the 2025/26 Championship play-offs under Sergej Jakirović. Manchester United finished third and qualified for the Champions League.
hull-vs-man-united.historicalContext: Hull’s promotion-winning core is largely retained; United are still shaping their XI under Carrick.
hull-vs-man-united.injuries: Provisional: the supplied research lists Enis Destan, Cody Drameh, John Egan, Jens Hjertø-Dahl, Matty Jacob, Patrick McNair and Liam Millar as unavailable, with Óscar Zambrano a hamstring doubt. Recheck before kick-off.
hull-vs-man-united.tacticalMatchup: United will look to exploit Hull’s patched defensive options through width and final-third quality.
hull-vs-man-united.outlook: United’s depth should matter, but Carrick is still bedding in his approach.

everton-vs-crystal-palace.overview: David Moyes’ Everton host Crystal Palace under new manager Pierre Sage at Hill Dickinson Stadium.
everton-vs-crystal-palace.recentForm: Everton finished 13th in 2025/26; Palace finished 15th domestically but won the UEFA Conference League under Oliver Glasner.
everton-vs-crystal-palace.historicalContext: The supplied research identifies a strong recent Everton record in this fixture, but flags conflicting reports of the most recent scoreline for official verification.
everton-vs-crystal-palace.injuries: Provisional: Everton’s packet lists Jack Grealish and Jarrad Branthwaite as longer-term absentees and Idrissa Gana Gueye as a doubt; Palace availability requires rechecking.
everton-vs-crystal-palace.tacticalMatchup: Sage inherits a squad built for Glasner’s system, while Moyes will seek to extend Everton’s effective approach against Palace.
everton-vs-crystal-palace.outlook: The managerial transition and fixture history make this a tight opening-weekend game.

nottingham-forest-vs-leeds.overview: Oliver Glasner starts at Forest against a more settled Leeds side led by Daniel Farke.
nottingham-forest-vs-leeds.recentForm: Forest finished 16th while reaching the Europa League semi-finals; Leeds finished 14th in their second season back.
nottingham-forest-vs-leeds.historicalContext: Forest enter with a fifth head coach in 12 months, while Leeds have greater continuity.
nottingham-forest-vs-leeds.injuries: Provisional: Leeds carried concerns around Jaka Bijol, Daniel James and Lukas Nmecha. Forest availability was not confirmed in the supplied snapshot.
nottingham-forest-vs-leeds.tacticalMatchup: Glasner’s more attacking, possession-oriented reputation meets Farke’s established unit.
nottingham-forest-vs-leeds.outlook: Forest’s attacking ceiling is higher, but early cohesion is the swing factor.

ipswich-vs-sunderland.overview: Gary O’Neil’s newly promoted Ipswich host Sunderland at Portman Road.
ipswich-vs-sunderland.recentForm: Ipswich finished runners-up in the Championship; Sunderland entered after a positive first season back in the Premier League.
ipswich-vs-sunderland.historicalContext: Ipswich have added several players and are still resolving their goalkeeper picture; Sunderland offer more continuity under Régis Le Bris.
ipswich-vs-sunderland.injuries: Provisional: Christian Walton was nearing a return from a foot issue. No major Sunderland absences were confirmed in the supplied snapshot.
ipswich-vs-sunderland.tacticalMatchup: Ipswich must find early defensive solidity amid turnover; Sunderland’s settled shape is the counterpoint.
ipswich-vs-sunderland.outlook: Goalkeeper uncertainty and summer turnover are the key variables.

brentford-vs-tottenham.overview: Keith Andrews’ Brentford host Roberto De Zerbi’s Tottenham at the Gtech Community Stadium.
brentford-vs-tottenham.recentForm: Brentford finished ninth in 2025/26; Tottenham endured a difficult season before De Zerbi helped secure safety.
brentford-vs-tottenham.historicalContext: Tottenham’s midfield investment and De Zerbi’s first full campaign frame the fixture.
brentford-vs-tottenham.injuries: Provisional: the supplied packet flags multiple Tottenham attacking options as unavailable or limited, with Brentford’s list unconfirmed.
brentford-vs-tottenham.tacticalMatchup: De Zerbi’s possession approach faces Brentford’s organised home pressing and direct threat.
brentford-vs-tottenham.outlook: Tottenham have the higher-quality spine, but Brentford’s home record makes this a toss-up.

brighton-vs-aston-villa.overview: Fabian Hürzeler’s Brighton host Unai Emery’s Aston Villa in a meeting of two comparatively settled teams.
brighton-vs-aston-villa.recentForm: Brighton finished eighth and qualified for the Conference League; Villa finished fourth and reached the Champions League again.
brighton-vs-aston-villa.historicalContext: The supplied research identifies Villa’s strong record against Brighton, including at the Amex.
brighton-vs-aston-villa.injuries: Provisional: Brighton and Villa both carried multiple fitness concerns that require confirmation closer to the match.
brighton-vs-aston-villa.tacticalMatchup: Villa’s compact transition game has historically been effective against Brighton’s possession approach.
brighton-vs-aston-villa.outlook: The specific head-to-head trend gives Villa the edge despite the fixture’s close overall quality.

man-city-vs-bournemouth.overview: Enzo Maresca takes charge of Manchester City’s first home league match of the post-Guardiola era against Marco Rose’s Bournemouth.
man-city-vs-bournemouth.recentForm: City finished second in 2025/26; Bournemouth finished sixth and qualified for Europe under Andoni Iraola.
man-city-vs-bournemouth.historicalContext: The supplied packet frames this as a transitional City side without Rodri against a Bournemouth side adapting from Iraola to Rose.
man-city-vs-bournemouth.injuries: Provisional: Rodri was listed as out after surgery, with Bournemouth’s Julio Soler and Lewis Cook carrying muscle concerns. Recheck before kick-off.
man-city-vs-bournemouth.tacticalMatchup: Maresca’s control principles face a high-pressing Bournemouth identity; City’s midfield structure without Rodri is central.
man-city-vs-bournemouth.outlook: City’s attack should carry them, but the transition and Rodri absence narrow the usual home advantage.

newcastle-vs-liverpool.overview: Matthias Jaissle’s Newcastle host Andoni Iraola’s Liverpool in a marquee opening-weekend clash of new systems.
newcastle-vs-liverpool.recentForm: Newcastle finished 12th in 2025/26; Liverpool finished fifth.
newcastle-vs-liverpool.historicalContext: The supplied packet describes significant Newcastle turnover and Liverpool’s pre-season fitness and injury questions.
newcastle-vs-liverpool.injuries: Provisional: multiple Liverpool absences and Newcastle concerns around Anthony Elanga, Lewis Hall and Fabian Schär require rechecking close to kick-off.
newcastle-vs-liverpool.tacticalMatchup: Two front-foot, pressing-minded coaches meet without a full runway to install their systems.
newcastle-vs-liverpool.outlook: Liverpool retain more attacking quality, but cohesion and fitness make the fixture less straightforward.

fulham-vs-chelsea.overview: Álvaro Arbeloa’s Fulham host Xabi Alonso’s Chelsea in a West London derby between two new coaching eras.
fulham-vs-chelsea.recentForm: Fulham and Chelsea both finished 2025/26 on 52 points.
fulham-vs-chelsea.historicalContext: Neither team’s first-choice XI under its new coach was settled in the supplied 14 August snapshot.
fulham-vs-chelsea.injuries: No major fixture-specific absences were confirmed in the supplied packet; recheck team news close to kick-off.
fulham-vs-chelsea.tacticalMatchup: Both clubs are implementing new identities, making early settling and control decisive.
fulham-vs-chelsea.outlook: This reads as a low-margin derby with no clear favourite.
